newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Avia Presto orders new palleting system.
newsitem.headline: Avia Presto orders new palleting system.

text.p: Avia Presto, a Dutch ground handling company, is to order an automated freight handling system for its Schiphol airport facility, the company said in a statement.

Avia, part of the Royal Pakhoed group of companies, said it is in discussions with Mannesmann Demag Fordertechnik, based in Offenbach in Germany. The German group specialises in highly automated freight handling equipment.
Avia said it is seeking to develop a pallet handling system at a cost of 22 million guilders for its new freight station which is under construction at the leading Dutch airport.

The new freight facility will be opened in August next year. Mannesmann will start installing the new system in March next year, Avia said. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
